title: Use Cases Bridge Settings
description: Structural schema for the optional root use-cases-bridge.yml. It configures helpers only: link transformers, validations (optional report name, optional run command, results transformer). Unique validation ids, transformer resolution and working_dir containment are core checks. Reports live in the run that reads them, never in the project.

transformer.description: A bundled transformer name (e.g. swift-testing) or a project-relative program path.

id.description: Segment grammar. Also the name of the validation's reports folder in each run, so names Windows reserves for devices are refused on every system. `record` is reserved for recorded verdicts.

report.description: Optional name of the report file or folder the tests write inside this validation's reports folder, .use-cases/runs/<run-id>/reports/<id>/. {report} is the absolute path of that name, or of the folder itself when report is omitted. A plain name, never a path: the core, not the project, decides where reports live.

run.description: Used by `use-cases verify --run` only. Direct exec, no shell. {report} is the only placeholder: the absolute path this run's report is written to. A word in braces that is a near miss of {report} (the same word in other letter case, or one edit from it, a swap of neighbouring letters counting as one, such as {reprot}) is refused by the core, by name; every other brace, a bare word in braces included, is plain text.

working_dir.description: Project-relative folder the run command runs in, and where relative paths in the report start. Defaults to the project root. Must exist, and never inside .use-cases/.
